subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue stay canonical for both the Google thinking sanitizer gap and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios auth-stack crash, or should maintainers split the auth-stack crash into a separate canonical issue?
rationale: The discussion and source evidence show two plausible failure slices with the same user-visible error, while open PRs cover only parts of the provider/auth surface.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Issue
options.body: Track both slices here until live Vertex proof shows the released user problem is gone.

options.title: Split Auth-Stack Follow-Up
options.body: Let the sanitizer PR land against this issue and move the ADC/gaxios dependency crash to a narrower issue with its own proof gate.

options.title: Close After Sanitizer Only
options.body: Treat the sanitizer fix as sufficient and rely on fresh reports for any remaining auth-stack failures.

recommendation.title: Keep One Canonical Issue
recommendation.body: Track both slices here until live Vertex proof shows the released user problem is gone.
